points: Hot path is estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2, called once per admitted detection (max_stage2 defaults to 2, serial, one shared rng). After the plane and raster, two_stage_chamfer_search_v2 always runs and, unless the free chamfer cost is at or below about 0.00623 m (lambda_eff = 3*(1-confidence) drops to the 0.05 floor only then), two_stage_chamfer_search_v2_with_prior runs as well. Default grids: free coarse 31 x 31 x 21 = 20181, free fine 25 x 25 x 13 = 8125, prior coarse 21 x 21 x 21 = 9261, prior fine another 8125, so 45692 chamfer_cost_from_rotated evaluations per detection on the common path, plus a handful of full chamfer_cost_v2 calls (pi-ambiguity pair, each stage's init pose, anchor cost, and a second data-only cost after the prior search discards prior_search_cost).

Published PoseResult does not use the chamfer argmin translation or heading. tx/ty/tz are the bbox-centre ray_plane_intersect_cross_camera hit transformed by R_dr, and yaw_rad is yaw_from_normal_camera of the plane normal. best_pose.theta_rad and the search cost are stored only on ChamferDebugV3_2. The O(10^4) bilinear grid search is still on every successful inference.

Inner-loop complexity is a full sort per candidate. The cached prototype has N=182 contour samples (outer 1.20 x 0.14 m plus two 0.47 x 0.10 m pockets at contour_spacing_m=0.03). trimmed_mean_from_distances copies all N distances into a std::vector and std::sorts them, then sums the shortest ceil(0.9*N)=164 for trim_fraction=0.10. Cost is O(T * N log N) with T about 45692, not a partial select of the kept prefix.

Extra copies inside chamfer_cost_from_rotated: every (x, y) candidate assigns tls.translated = rotated (182 x 2 doubles) and then adds tx and ty, even though rotate_proto_into already cached the rotation for that theta. rotate_proto_into itself does out = proto * R.transpose(), an Eigen product temporary. sample_bilinear_into then indexes that MatrixXd as (i, 0) and (i, 1), which is strided in column-major storage. OpenMP schedule(static) amortizes the rotation across a theta slice but does not remove the per-candidate translate copy or the sort.

The one-shot image dependency before the search is OpenCV on an oversized grid. rasterize_points_to_mask uses padding_m=0.80 and resolution_m=0.005, adding 320 pixels of empty border on each side, so a roughly 1.2 m by 0.2 m face becomes about 561 x 361. close_mask clones the mask, runs an elliptical MORPH_CLOSE, connectedComponentsWithStats, and writes a second full zero image. compute_distance_transform_v2 then compare-builds an 8-bit source, calls cv::distanceTransform with DIST_L2 and DIST_MASK_PRECISE, and convertTo-copies the result to CV_32FC1. That precise distance transform is the OpenCV cost that dominates the pre-search work; the search then bilinear-samples it T times.

sample_face_points scans the entire depth frame per admitted detection, not the bbox. Each finite pixel in [depth_min_m, depth_max_m] does a K_depth_inv ray, an SE3 into RGB, a pinhole project, and a lookup in a full RGB-sized mask. Accepted points are push_back'd into per-thread std::vector buckets and then copied row-by-row into a column-major Eigen::MatrixXd. build_bbox_mask allocates a full RGB height-by-width zero mask and erodes the whole image (erode_px=2). depth_image_to_meters convertTo-copies the whole depth image to CV_32FC1 once per synced pair, before that scan repeats for each admitted box.

Plane fitting materializes the inlier cloud three times and allocates per RANSAC trial. ransac_plane_fit (ransac_iters=100, early stop at inlier ratio 0.85) builds a new residual ArrayXd and bool mask every iteration, copies inliers into a fresh MatrixXd, and JacobiSVD-refits. estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 then calls plane_inlier_mask (another points*normal residual) and copies those inliers again into plane_points_3d. project_points_to_plane_2d allocates a full relative-point matrix plus the 2D result, and estimate_pca_long_axis allocates another centred copy of every 2D inlier. Those passes are smaller than the chamfer grid, and they run again for the second admitted detection.
